Remove job-wide credentials so native package and dependency setup steps cannot inherit the read token; scope it to the two steps that call trusted admission or collection code.
Snapshot admission and dispatch binding require the read credential; expose it only to this binding step, which also checks request and subject identity before candidate code runs.
Separate public apt and checksum-pinned FFmpeg installation from dependency preparation so the credential-bearing GitHub steps remain isolated from native installers.
Move the existing apt and FFmpeg commands into their dedicated steps exactly once, preserving installation behavior while making the credential boundary explicit.
Dependency preparation uses pinned project dependencies and local build commands only; it does not require a GitHub token.
The candidate collector reads private source evidence; scope READINESS_READ_TOKEN to this exact collection step rather than the full job.

local_contracts.name: FFmpeg installation remains public, version-pinned, and SHA-256 checked
local_contracts.evidence: install_ffmpeg.sh uses a fixed BtbN release URL and archive_sha256, rejects overrides, and reads no GitHub token.

local_contracts.name: CI remains named CI with pull_request safety and CI Summary as its sole required context
local_contracts.evidence: Workflow diff changes only FFmpeg step token scopes; CI name, pull_request trigger, and config/ci_required_checks.json remain unchanged.

local_contracts.name: Nightly incident and qualification controls remain event-specific
local_contracts.evidence: Workflow diff changes only the FFmpeg installer token scope; schedule-only incident jobs and Nightly trigger remain unchanged.

local_contracts.name: Release continues to bind CI evidence to the exact source SHA
local_contracts.evidence: Workflow diff changes only the FFmpeg installer token scope; the release gate still queries workflow runs by head_sha and filters exact equality.

local_contracts.name: Readiness retention credentials are limited to admission and candidate collection
local_contracts.evidence: READINESS_READ_TOKEN is present only on the dispatch-binding step and authenticated collector step; native package and dependency setup has no token.
